basis:
J-FWD screw preload re-check on the CHANGELOG 234 (1)(b)/(c) basis (lead 2026-10-20, REV-MECH-2 RM2-01 addenda).  Hand calc, no FE.
Mechanical, 2026-10-20.  Every number DERIVED unless tagged.
v2 (2026-10-20, after the lead's 'J-FWD 3.0 N m ACCEPTED'): the selected torque is the lead's 3.0 N m (the v1 rule on the uniform joint
temperature still gives 4.0 N m, kept as rule_selection_uniform_T_Nm; at 4.0 N m the GVLO gap-variant soak fails the screw tension,
jfwd_variant_v352_v1 / v2); the sweep adds 3.0 and 2.5 N m; the J-F1 acceptance is the lowest allowed installation preload over the LC2
uniform-temperature checks below and every check of jfwd_variant_v352_v2.json (every B1 frame, merged / GVLO / GVHI); the 2.5 N m
fallback rows; the intervals at the selected torque.  v1 = jfwd_preload_v352_v1.py -> jfwd_preload_v352_v1.json 5dbcb3597d009b0e (kept).

Joint: v3.5.2 J-FWD = 10x ISO 7380-1 M5 x 10 A4-80 (HW-101) radial, TC-01 case (6061-T6) to TC-02 head (6061-T6), az 18 + 36k deg
(jfwd_v352_v1.json 790e379ef3c00179, option O1).  Bearing-type joint (234 (1)(c): friction below the joint load at LC2 and FA1S).
Loads: head axial load F = p x pi/4 x 57.25^2 (case bore at the O-rings = the pressure diameter; vacuum outside, i.e. p absolute),
shared equally by the 10 screws (match-drilled holes, ASSUMED): LC2 chamber MEOP 4.5 MPa (loadcases_v1 LC2) -> 11.58 kN; FA1S 151.04 bar abs
-> 38.88 kN (v1 used the gauge value 38.62 kN; the absolute value is used here, +0.7 %).
Ruled checks (234 (1)(b), NASA-STD-5020A form, AS RECALLED, TO-VERIFY):
  LC2 (SF 1.5 / 2.0, part temperature): yield  sigma_vm = sqrt((F_max / A_s)^2 + 3 (SF_y V / A_3)^2) <= k_T Rp0.2;
                                        ultimate Rt^2 + Rs^2 <= 1, Rt = F_max / (k_Tu Rm A_s), Rs = SF_u V / (0.6 k_Tu Rm A_3);
  FA1S (FA-1 rule SF 1.0 / 1.0, 188 (9) -> 177): ultimate interaction with F_max must pass; yield shear-only on the minor area with
                                        the preload-relaxation argument and the 233 (4) inspect-or-replace rule.
F_max = 1.25 F_nom (ruled maximum installation preload), F_min = 0.75 F_nom (ASSUMED symmetric scatter), F_nom = T / (K d), K = 0.20
(ASSUMED; thread locker torque-tension coefficient not stated in the Henkel TDS -> TO-VERIFY by a torque-tension test on HW-101 in a
6061-T6 tap coupon; the +25 % bound holds for K >= 0.16).
Sensitivity added by Mechanical (not in the ruled basis): thermal preload rise of the steel screw clamping the aluminium case wall,
dF_th = (alpha_Al - alpha_A4) dT L_grip k_b k_m / (k_b + k_m) (CALC; k_b, k_m ASSUMED stiff-member estimates below).  The case bore at the
screw row is not pressurised (the plug O-rings g1/g2 are 15-21 mm below the row; shell decay length ~7.5 mm), so no pressure term.
Screw temperature (SIM, B1 v352_NF2b merged thermal, TC-01/TC-02 nodes r 21.5-31.75 within +/- 2.6 mm of the screw row): 78.6 C at the end
of the B1 burn (21.65 s; LC2 'part temperature'), 54.2 C end of A1 burn 2, 45.6 C at the A1 relight (FA1S), 119.7 C soak maximum (166.7 s,
no pressure).  The gap-conductance variant (fit J1 open) can raise TC-02 at the row: LC2 is also evaluated at 100 C (bound pending the variant).
k_T, k_Tu: hot factors of A4-80 = engmat SS316L Fty(T)/Fty(20), Ftu(T)/Ftu(20) (ASSUMED proxy; the reviewer's 'hot' 0.875 = this
factor at 79 C).  A4-80 RT minima Rp0.2 600 / Rm 800 MPa (ISO 3506-1 class 80, LITERATURE via engmat SS-A4-80).
Thread locker (method M-T1L): Henkel LOCTITE 243 (medium strength) or equivalent, service -55 to +180 C (Hoffmann Group 083301 243 listing,
https://www.hoffmann-group.com/MT/en/mbbridge/p/083301-243, accessed 2026-10-20, DATASHEET-distributor); Henkel TDS 'new formulation'
March 2010 (https://static.rapidonline.com/pdf/12-4132o_v1.pdf, accessed 2026-10-20): M10 steel breakaway 26 N m, M10 stainless breakloose
17 N m (pre-torque 5 N m, 1 week 22 C), works on passive substrates (stainless) [DATASHEET]; hot strength / heat ageing only as charts
(values TO-VERIFY); no K value stated.
selection_basis: lead decision 2026-10-20 ('J-FWD 3.0 N m ACCEPTED': HW-101 at 3.0 N m, M-T1L, LOCTITE 243). The v1 rule (highest torque in the sweep with every uniform-temperature check >= 0) gives 4 N m; at 4.0 N m the GVLO gap-variant soak takes the screw tension to MS -0.118 (t 63.651 s, TC-01 / TC-02 row 157.9 / 95.8 C; jfwd_variant_v352_v2.json c67c9ab17c37a2c1); at 3.0 N m it is +0.054 (k_sh x0.5 +0.128, x1.5 -0.008, shown as found)

selected.thread_locker: LOCTITE 243 (Henkel, medium strength) or an equivalent medium-strength anaerobic thread locker rated -55..+180 C; J-FWD row maxima (SIM, B1 v352_NF2b, jfwd_variant_v352_v2): TC-01 wall 158.0 C, TC-02 tap zone (where the locker is) 119.6 C, screw mean 127.3 C: below the 180 C rating

K_validity.note: [K_min, F_max allowed (N)]: the LC2 combined yield check at 3 N m stays >= 0 for an actual nut factor at or above K_min (preload = T / (K d)); the ruled +25 % bound equals K 0.16 at K_nom 0.20. The Loctite 243 wet-locker K is NOT stated in the TDS: TO-VERIFY by a torque-tension test of HW-101 in a 6061-T6 M5-6H coupon with the locker (acceptance: the highest measured preload at 3 N m <= 6144 N, the 78.6 C LC2 check with the thermal rise; <= 5517 N for the 100 C bound) | v2: J-F1 acceptance = the lowest of these and the gap-variant limits: <= 4096 N (K >= 0.1465), see J-F1_acceptance

LC2_temperature_limit.note: uniform joint temperature at which the LC2 check at the selected torque reaches MS 0 (k_T, k_Tu from the SS316L proxy table; thermal rise per dF_th): the gap-conductance variant J-FWD-row temperature at the end of the burn is compared with these limits

selected.FA1S_preload_relaxation_argument: The installation preload is a displacement-controlled, self-relieving load (set by the screw stretch at tightening), not an external load. At FA1S (abnormal, one event, SF 1.0) the combined check with the +25 % preload reaches k_T Rp0.2 at about 140 bar abs; above that the screw yields in tension over its free thread, which lowers the preload and does not lower the shear capacity: the shear on the minor area alone stays below 0.577 k_T Rp0.2 at 151.04 bar abs (MS +0.068) and the ultimate interaction with the full +25 % preload passes (MS +0.361). So the joint carries FA1S without shear yield or rupture; what it may lose is preload, and the screws may carry a small permanent stretch. Hence the 233 (4) rule: all 10 HW-101 are replaced (new screws, fresh locker) and the holes and taps gauged after any recorded Pc above 60 bar abs. At 60 bar abs the combined check with the +25 % preload and the 78.6 C thermal rise has MS +0.433 (no yield below the rule's threshold).

check_60bar_abs_SF1_78.6C.label: 60 bar abs, SF 1.0, 78.6 C, max preload + thermal

TC02_internal_thread_shear.basis: FED-STD-H28 strip area, L_eff 6.35 mm, max preload + thermal rise, unfactored (installation load)

retention.statement: At 3 N m the friction capacity (mu 0.2 ASSUMED) is 4.50 kN at the minimum preload and 6.00 kN at the nominal preload with a cold joint, both below the LC1 joint load (6.44 kN): the head is expected to slip into bearing at the first pressurisation of a normal firing (at 5.53 N m it held, 8.29 kN). LC2 and FA1S were bearing-type at any torque (234 (1)(c)). Once in bearing the screws are shear pins at LC1 too: case bearing 41.2 MPa per screw at LC1 (unfactored) against Fbry 324 MPa (78.6 C), so hole damage per firing is not expected; the slip (up to the 0.26 mm radial hole clearance, match-drilled) is a one-way settle to bearing, then a small cyclic bearing load each firing: fretting and wear are covered by the gauge interval. Loosening: the thread locker, not the preload, retains the screw (M-T1L); the bore O-rings g1/g2 are radial seals and do not depend on the axial position within the hole clearance (FEA3D's 231 (3) contact sub-model with preload at nominal and +25 % confirms the slip and bearing)

hole_bearing_sizing.FA1S: jfwd_v352_v1.json O1: case bearing +0.338 / +0.649, tap bearing +1.248 / +1.771 (45 C, SF 1.0; preload-independent)

intervals_ASSUMED_until_test.HW101_replacement: replace all 10 HW-101 (new screws, fresh LOCTITE 243, M-T1L at 3 N m) at every J-FWD disassembly (the locker is single-use) and at the latest every 10 firings; immediately after any recorded Pc above 60 bar abs (233 (4)). 10 firings ASSUMED until a test: torque-tension plus breakaway / prevailing torque of HW-101 in a 6061-T6 M5-6H coupon after 10 thermal cycles 20 -> 120 C
intervals_ASSUMED_until_test.gauge_TC01_holes_TC02_taps: gauge all 10 TC-01 holes (plain pin gauges GO 5.50 / NO-GO 5.68, i.e. Phi 5.5 H13 per ISO 273 medium / ISO 286, drawing tolerance TO-DEFINE) and all 10 TC-02 taps (ISO 1502 M5-6H GO / NO-GO thread plug gauges) after firing 1, then every 5 firings and at every HW-101 replacement, and after any recorded Pc above 45 bar abs (MEOP exceeded). Reject: hole NO-GO enters or visible elongation / fretting on the bearing side; tap GO does not run to depth or NO-GO enters more than 2 turns -> part to MRB (a helical-coil repair is NOT pre-approved: it changes the strip area and needs a re-check). 5 firings ASSUMED until the first gauge results

fea3d_contact_submodel_parameter.thermal_rise: not added to these numbers: CALC +215 N at 45.6 C / +501 N at 78.6 C if the sub-model does not carry the screw / case differential expansion itself

J-F1_acceptance.governing: variant_GVLO_ksh_x1 (soak_tension_yield, t 63.651 s, TC-01 / TC-02 157.9 / 95.8 C)

k_sh_x1.5_sensitivity.note: if the case shell is 50 % stiffer than estimated (k_sh ASSUMED +/-50 %)

J-F1_acceptance.statement: J-F1 at 3 N m passes when every reading is <= 4096 N (K >= 0.1465; governing: variant_GVLO_ksh_x1 (soak_tension_yield, t 63.651 s, TC-01 / TC-02 157.9 / 95.8 C)) and >= 2250 N (K <= 0.267, the -25 % scatter bound used for the retention statement). With k_sh x1.5 the limit is 3697 N (K >= 0.1623); the ruled +25 % preload at K 0.20 is 3750 N

fallback_2.5Nm.use: fallback if J-F1 at 3 N m gives a reading above 4096 N, or if the lead lowers the torque: the allowed preload is the same 4096 N, so at 2.5 N m J-F1 needs K >= 0.1221

LC1_bearing_retention.statement: bearing-type at LC1 as at 3.0 N m (friction below the LC1 joint load at the nominal preload); the case and tap bearing margins do not depend on the preload
